reason: An independent pre-analysis audit found that the prior selector used confirmation completeness and same-plate metadata, that the confirmatory runner did not enforce every frozen input and parameter, and that several manuscript labels overstated blinding, replication, and diagnostic paired-swap validity.
scientific_corrections: The paper now states well-defined reagent versions, no cross-well interference, swap-invariant block retention, and conditional assignment uniformity.
The adaptive Euler sweep and four-pixel 8-connected component filter are defined to match the implementation.
The nine nonprimary pairs are called a secondary-contrast family rather than biological replications.
Raw-coordinate and moment-registration paired-swap values are labeled diagnostics rather than exact causal tests.
Generated nuisance elements are described as excluded from estimator inputs, not as independently blinded.
SHA-256 sidecars are described as integrity records rather than externally timestamped cryptographic seals.
The exact-test theorem now conditions assignment uniformity on the complete potential-outcome schedule and pretreatment design information.
The exact-test implementation, including statistics.py, is mechanically hash-gated before analysis.
The image downloader and confirmatory runner now reject metadata that differ from the source SHA-256 frozen in the discovery selection manifest.
outcome_access_statement: No RxRx1 image feature, test statistic, p-value, interval, secondary-contrast result, negative-control result, or robustness result had been computed or inspected. Image files retrieved before this amendment were handled only by archive-member extraction and integrity checks. The replacement discovery-only selector produced exactly the same ordered pairs and scores before any RxRx1 image analysis.
